liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer says the opening Bertha shows the band fired up by Keith Godchaux's arrival within seconds [13]
- **Come A Time** (1 review): Reviewer says this is a big version with extra verses [5]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Billy plays a nice lead-in to a sizzling Other One [10]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Wharf Rat masterful and spellbinding [14]

## The recordings

- **gd71-10-19.orefm.clugston.3301.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 29 songs; 182 min; rated 4.41/5 by 41 [1]. Said about its sound: The pre-FM source sounds much better than the thin-sounding FM recording; Reviewer complains of distortion problems throughout this recording, rating the sound poor; Reviewer considers the distortion unimportant, noting how far the circulating tapes of such shows have come [3][7][10]
- **gd1971-10-19.sbd.miller.114351.flac16**: soundboard; 26 songs; 182 min; rated 3.85/5 by 13 [2]

## Around the show

- Pigpen was out, and Keith filled in, playing strong piano and an organ style reminiscent of T.C [3]
- New Riders opened the show [8]
- The two bands played about six and a half hours, with Garcia on stage throughout [8]
- Tickets cost $4.50 [8]
- This was Keith's first show with the band [11]
- The announcer's intro explains that Pigpen is sick and Keith is filling in [11]
- Reviewer says Jack Straw, Tennessee Jed, Mexicali Blues, Comes a Time, One More Saturday Night and Ramble On Rose were first played here [9]
- Reviewer groups this show with the U Mich show as energetic, hot performances despite Pigpen's absence [10]
- Reviewer recommends the 9-29-71 practice tape with Keith as a companion listen [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-10-19.orefm.clugston.3301.sbeok.shnf**: source: PreFM Soundboard Reels > DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Pre-FM soundboard reels transferred to DAT, then CDR; encoded to SHN with EAC by Scott Clugston [1]
- **gd1971-10-19.sbd.miller.114351.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Reel Master (7 inch 1/4 track) -> Dat (48k) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.gdao.org: [Grateful Dead - Fall '71 Tour, October 19, 1971, Northrop Auditorium, Minneapolis, MN · Grateful Dead Archive Online · G](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/382050) [16]
- Poster by jpc.de: [Grateful Dead: Northrop Auditorium Minneapolis Oct. 19 1971 (3 CDs)](https://www.jpc.de/jpcng/poprock/detail/-/art/grateful-dead-northrop-auditorium-minneapol/hnum/8556887) [17]
